import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrame
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Identify common features available in both train and test
# Based on schema inspection, 'request_text' is only in train, so we use 'request_text_edit_aware'
# Numerical features available in both
numerical_cols = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Filter columns to ensure they exist
numerical_cols = [
    c for c in numerical_cols if c in train_df.columns and c in test_df.columns
]

# Text features
text_col = "request_text_edit_aware"
title_col = "request_title"

# Fill NaNs in text columns
train_df[text_col] = train_df[text_col].fillna("")
train_df[title_col] = train_df[title_col].fillna("")
test_df[text_col] = test_df[text_col].fillna("")
test_df[title_col] = test_df[title_col].fillna("")

# Combine text for vectorization
train_df["combined_text"] = train_df[text_col] + " " + train_df[title_col]
test_df["combined_text"] = test_df[text_col] + " " + test_df[title_col]

# Feature Engineering: Text Length
train_df["text_length"] = train_df["combined_text"].apply(len)
test_df["text_length"] = test_df["combined_text"].apply(len)

# Prepare Numerical Features
X_train_num = train_df[numerical_cols].fillna(0)
X_test_num = test_df[numerical_cols].fillna(0)

# Scale Numerical Features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_num_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_num)
X_test_num_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_num)

# Text Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english")
tfidf.fit(train_df["combined_text"])
X_train_text = tfidf.transform(train_df["combined_text"])
X_test_text = tfidf.transform(test_df["combined_text"])

# Combine Features
X_train_full = hstack([csr_matrix(X_train_num_scaled), X_train_text])
X_test_full = hstack([csr_matrix(X_test_num_scaled), X_test_text])

# Target
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Split for Validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train XGBoost Model
print("Training XGBoost model...")
params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

model = xgb.XGBClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Predict on Validation
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Retrain on full training data for submission
print("Retraining on full training data...")
model_final = xgb.XGBClassifier(**params)
model_final.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

# Predict on Test
test_preds = model_final.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)

# Save Submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
